Portronics Revvo Power Bank With Wireless Charger – Smart Power for Everyday Use

The Portronics Revvo Power Bank With Wireless Charger is designed for users who demand speed, convenience, and premium performance in one compact device. With a powerful 10000mAh capacity, advanced 15W wireless charging, and ultra-fast 22.5W wired output, this power bank ensures your devices stay charged wherever life takes you.

Built with an integrated the Revvo offers hands-free charging while streaming, working, or video calling. Available in elegant Black, Blue, and Mocha color options, it combines functionality with modern aesthetics, making it an ideal choice for professionals, travelers, and tech enthusiasts.

Key Features

  • 15W Wireless Max Output – Fast and stable wireless charging for compatible smartphones
  • 22.5W Wired Output – Ultra-fast charging via USB and Type-C ports
  • 10000mAh Battery Capacity – Reliable all-day power backup
  • MagSafe Phone Stand – Secure magnetic attachment with built-in stand
  • Dual Charging Modes – Use wired and wireless charging simultaneously
  • Sleek Color Options – Black, Blue, and Mocha finishes
  • Multi-Layer Protection – Overcharge, overheat, and short-circuit safety

Fast & Efficient Wireless Charging Experience

The 15W wireless max output ensures efficient power delivery without overheating or power loss. Simply snap your compatible smartphone onto the magnetic surface and enjoy seamless charging without tangled cables. The MagSafe-compatible design keeps your device perfectly aligned for consistent performance. Whether you’re at home, in the office, or on the move, the offers a clutter-free charging solution that fits effortlessly into your daily routine.

22.5W Wired Output for Rapid Charging

When speed matters, the 22.5W wired output delivers high-speed charging for smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and other USB-powered devices. The advanced power delivery technology optimizes output based on your device, ensuring faster charging while protecting battery health. This makes the Revvo an excellent choice for users who carry multiple devices and need dependable power throughout the day.

Built-In MagSafe for Hands-Free Convenience

The integrated MagSafe phone stand transforms this into a functional desk companion. Watch videos, attend virtual meetings, or browse social media while your phone charges wirelessly. The strong magnetic grip ensures stability, even during movement.

Portable Design with Premium Finish

Designed with portability in mind, the 10000mAh power bank fits easily into pockets, backpacks, or travel kits. Its premium matte finish and stylish colors—Black, Blue, and Mocha—add a touch of sophistication to your tech accessories.

Why Choose?

  • Ideal for daily travel, office use, and emergencies
  • Supports wireless and wired fast charging
  • Perfect for MagSafe-compatible smartphones
  • Trusted Portronics build quality and safety standards
  • Modern design with functional versatility

Perfect Power Solution for Modern Lifestyles

If you’re looking for a reliable, stylish, and high-performance the stands out as a complete charging solution. Its combination of 15W wireless charging, 22.5W wired output, and MagSafe stand functionality makes it a must-have accessory for today’s fast-paced digital life. Stay powered, stay connected, and charge smarter with Revvo.
